{{bedbug_host_policy}} (Host will promptly investigate and treat any reported bedbug concerns / Guest should report any suspected bedbugs immediately)

Guest should inspect bedding, mattress seams, and furniture for signs of bedbugs upon arrival. Guest should report any suspected bedbugs to Host immediately. Guest is responsible for any damage caused by bedbugs introduced by Guest.

blocks.text: California law requires landlords to provide information about bedbug history and to disclose any known bedbug infestations. This disclosure is provided in compliance with applicable California law (California Code of Regulations, Title 24, § 1000 et seq. and related local ordinances).
Guest acknowledges having received this Bedbug History Disclosure and understands the importance of promptly reporting any suspected bedbug activity.
